claim: The PR moves `div_eq_inv_self`, `div_left_injective` and `div_left_inj` to `[DivInvMonoid G] [IsRightCancelMul G]`, and `div_eq_self`, `div_right_injective` and `div_right_inj` to `[DivisionMonoid G] [IsLeftCancelMul G]`. No other declaration in Mathlib uses either typeclass combination. No Mathlib type is a cancellative `DivInvMonoid` without also being a group: the natural non-group division monoids (groups with zero, pointwise `Set`/`Finset`) have an absorbing element (`0`, `∅`) and are not cancellative. The PR states it has no intended use. The generalisation therefore adds new, unused hypothesis shapes to six simp/API lemmas and their additive versions, and reorders a stable part of the `Group` section.
requested_change: Keep these six lemmas (and their `to_additive` versions) in `section Group` with `[Group G]`, and drop the matching typeclass changes in Finset/Basic.lean and Set/Finite.lean. Revisit the generalisation when a concrete non-group instance needs it.
